outcome.technical: Implemented the mechanical half of F633's reviewer-convergence fixes, inside this task's declared files only. In _filed_returns.py: unsupported_match_basis(description, note) + _clause_quoted(), and return_problems/_reviewer_problems now take an optional `task` so a reviewer's `matches` answer whose note quotes no 4-word run of the task's own `description` is refused as unsupported before it can file (wired through drive-phase.py's submitted_shape, which now threads `task` for mode:task reviewer submissions only - mode:phase stays task=None, unaffected). In drive-phase.py: claim_section(task, filed_return) builds the task-description-first, return-labelled-as-claim block (pure, not yet wired into audit-lookup.py's brief composer, which is NOT in this task's files); tests_add_gaps(task, filed_titles) names declared tests.add entries with no filed counterpart, matched by verbatim clause or an explicit task-level tests.addMap entry, never fuzzy - wired into submit() so the drive reports gaps as a did-line at filing time, non-blocking; floor_contradicted_clause(findings) raises a low severity to med when the issue text carries the marker 'contradicts task clause' - wired into submit() for reviewer filings before they are written; run_falsifier(cmd, tree, mutation) applies a {file,find,replace} mutation to a tempfile.mkdtemp() copy of tree (never the executor's own tree), runs cmd there, and grades survived/killed/could-not-run (a SyntaxError/ImportError/zero-collected signature, or a `find` absent from the file, is could-not-run, never a kill). Documented the four mechanisms in reference/phase-signoff.md next to where findings are recorded; left agents/audit-reviewer.md untouched since it is already at 6992/7000 bytes and none of these four are reviewer-prompt-facing (they are drive- and shape-validation-side). Fixed a pre-existing test helper (_file_reviewer in test_drive_phase.py) to quote the task's own description in its default note, since the new unsupported-match check would otherwise refuse every per-task reviewer fixture in the suite (`review.perTask: always`) that used a generic 'as asked' note - this was the one behavioural ripple from wiring the check live; after that fix the whole suite is green. NOT DONE, and explicitly out of scope: (a) test_audit_task.py's 'design source names :focus/:hover -> interaction-state parity case in tests.add' - the source file this needs (scripts/manifest/audit-task.py) is not in this task's Files list, has no existing design-source/parity concept to extend, and is a large, unexplored file; I did not touch it rather than guess at a brand-new CSS-parsing feature there. (b) The reviewer BRIEF's actual text (task-first ordering, the clause-quoting rule stated to the model, tests.add carried into the brief) is composed by scripts/status/audit-lookup.py's compose_reviewer_brief/compose_phase_brief, which is also not in this task's Files list; claim_section() is the pure, tested building block for that ordering but is not wired into the brief audit-lookup.py writes. Verified: ran `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest` (243/243 cases passed) and `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test__filed_returns.py --selftest` (68/68 cases passed) directly; ran `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py` once in the tree per the orchestrator's note - first run surfaced two real regressions from this change (pn0: a 'N of M' ratio claim in a new docstring; nw4: a text-mode write with no `newline=` in run_falsifier) and one register citation (F633 cited in three new docstrings/comments) - all three fixed, then reran: 332/332 files ok, 152 migrated to tests/, 15920 cases, exit 0. Ran `python3 tools/measure-context.py --gate --tree plugins/audit` (reviewer 6992/7000 unchanged, GATE OK), `python3 plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/validate-manifest.py docs/audit/audit-plan.json` (valid, unchanged), `claude plugin validate .` and `claude plugin validate plugins/audit` (both pass), `ruff check` and `vermin -t=3.8-` over the five edited files (clean).
outcome.descriptive: The drive now floors a contradicted-clause finding to med, names a tests.add case with no filed counterpart, refuses a reviewer's unsupported `matches`, and can run a per-test falsifier in a throwaway copy of the tree; the reviewer-brief ordering and the audit-task.py interaction-state synthesis remain undone, outside this task's file scope.
